IT-3252                                                                                                                  about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 12-Jun-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  CYBER SECURITY [IT-3252]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Describe the suggestions, steps and best practices to be followed by the organization to  
  prevent security risks.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Determine and explain in detail with examples the scope of the unified threat  
  management appliance for attacks, internet threats, and protection mechanisms with          (5)  
  respect to TCP protocol.  
  
  2)           Identify and explain in detail the Security controls and mechanisms which can be used to  
  stop the Installation and Command & Control stage of the cyber kill chain.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Identify and explain in detail TCP Syn flooding attacks and propose any solution to  
  mitigate it.                                                                                (5)  
  
  3)           Identify and explain in detail the fields which is been analysed and used for OS  
  Detection.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze and explain with examples the output fields of tool named "whois" which is  
  used in reconnaissance phase of cyber kill chain                                            (5)  
  
  4)           Determine and explain the different audit record fields which can be used by IDS to  
  perform its functionalities  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Examine and explain in detail the different components of Snort tool.                       (5)  
  5)           Examine and explain in detail the working of the SOCKS protocol and how it is  
  correlated to circuit-level gateways.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Demonstrate the working, location and configuration of firewalls with respect to De-  
  Militarized zones with proper explanation with the help of the diagram                      (5)
